new_series.title: The Graham Norton Show
new_series.synopsis: Tom Cruise, Florence Pugh, Lolly Adefope and John Bishop join Graham on his sofa. With music from Emeli Sandé.

new_series.title: Marble Hall Murders
new_series.synopsis: Back in London, Susan Ryeland is once again corralled into the world of Atticus Pünd as he investigates a mystery in Corfu.

new_series.title: Blue Lights
new_series.synopsis: The section is challenged by escalating tensions at a community event, while the investigation into Dana Morgan’s drug partnership with Tina McIntyre falters.

new_series.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
new_series.synopsis: In avant-garde Paris, Eva explores the haute cuisine tradition of the ‘art of the table’ and meets young chefs on the cutting edge of a new food scene.

new_series.title: Strictly - It Takes Two
new_series.synopsis: It Takes Two is back with new host Ellie Taylor for a series packed full of the latest headlines, backstage gossip, expert opinions and exclusive interviews.

new_series.title: The Golden Cobra
new_series.synopsis: The Golden Cobra is now the number one curry house in Ebbw Vale, but a shark attack puts Basil's new-found success at risk. Jub reconnects with a friend from childhood.

new_series.title: Schitt's Creek
new_series.synopsis: On their way to drop off Alexis at the airport, David stops to scout a potential wedding venue and holds things up. Johnny and Moira have a romantic picnic by the creek.

new_series.title: Ice Road Truckers
new_series.synopsis: Lisa’s engine fails on her first run, Todd attempts a bold bush fix, Scooter squeezes his wide load through tight winter roads, and Shaun finds his key ice route too thin to cross.

new_series.title: Stacey Dooley Sleeps Over
new_series.synopsis: At nine years old, Autumn has 36 guns of her own and a dedicated YouTube channel where she reviews and tests out weapons. Stacey meets the family in Oklahoma at their very own shooting range.

new_series.title: Understand
new_series.synopsis: Michael Palin and Michael Rosen discuss what being a man in their 80s means to them. A conversation about grief, fading competitive instincts, and the benefits of letting go.

new_series.title: Stations by Louise Kennedy
new_series.synopsis: Teenager Róisín is asked to be a go-between for her school bully and local rogue Red Camelin.

new_series.title: Limelight
new_series.synopsis:
Maita goes to see her dad for her birthday, but he's disappeared. 
Five-part thriller by Eno Mfon and Darragh Mortell, starring Saffron Coomber and John Pfumojena.

new_series.title: Drama on 4
new_series.synopsis: Riverbourne's tower block is falling apart: damp, mould, faulty wiring, broken lifts. When the housing association looks away, the tenants organise and demand change.

new_series.title: World of Secrets
new_series.synopsis: When Yusron, the school’s former golden boy, gets in touch with Zia, a fellow former student, everything he believes in begins to unravel.
